text_block_list.text:
Just as I was about to wrap up training,
I noticed Tosen Jordan looking out at the track.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I just remembered I have something to do.
Go on ahead without me~.

Even so, I was still worried.
When I followed her to check on her—

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: *pant*... *pant*...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Ngh... My time isn't improving at all...
I've been running so much... why...?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: 'Sup. Hey, got a sec?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
—Ah, Jordan-san!
Y-Yes! Um... what is it?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, head to the classroom ahead of me~
The empty classroom next to the nurse's office is a great secret spot, you know.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
U-Um?
Excuse me—!?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Umm, I'm pretty sure that was in the Trainer's Room—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, geez!
Scared me half to death... You're still here?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"...Well, perfect timing.
Hey, lend me the key to the Trainer's office."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I need it pronto. For real!
It looks like Tosen Jordan is planning to do something to Daiwa Scarlet...
choice_data_list: Don't push yourself too hard, okay?
Don't push yourself too hard, okay?

text_block_list.text: It looks like Tosen Jordan is planning to do something to Daiwa Scarlet...
choice_data_list: Don't push yourself too hard, okay?
Don't push yourself too hard, okay?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Piece of cake.
Don't go underestimating my stamina.
choice_data_list: So, shall we try increasing the training load?
So, wanna try upping the training load?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Huh? Ah, no... how do I put it...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...Ghh, bring it on! I'll do it!
Don't underestimate a gal who's always down for anything!?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"Starting tomorrow, I'm gonna pop your eyes wide open!
You'd better be ready!"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Does something like that even exist?
I taught them a straight, easy-to-run route from here to the Trainer's office.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Fo' real!? Which means...
I can slack off until the very last second before practice—!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
—Jordan, Jordan!
Jeez, don't take it so seriously~~!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Well, you're definitely a pro when it comes to running.
...You really saved me, thanks.

After leaving the training grounds and walking through the academy,
I heard lively voices coming from one of the rooms.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Ta-da☆ Whaddya think?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: T-That's quite a lot of nail art sets... isn't it? Well... um, I should be heading to practice soon...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Come on, what's the harm in a little fun?
What kind of design should we go with?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Marble? French? Ah, favorite character nails?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Ngh, ...I'm sorry, Senpai.
I have to run... so...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Man, running non-stop is such a drag.
You gotta have break time, right?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Now's not the time to be saying that—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: "It's fine, it'll dry right off. Besides... aren't we wasting time doing this?"

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Gah! ...Th-Then,
please, please make it really quick!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Of course, leave it to me~.
I'm basically a pro when it comes to nails!
Come on, tell me what kind of motif you'd like.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Umm...... how about, Scarlet, or something?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Scarlett?
...Did you want your face in it?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: N-N-No, you've got it wrong! I meant the flower!!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
What I'm talking about is
a cute, vivid red flower that blooms in summer, and...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...These flowers hold memories of my mother and grandmother.
On our way home after I won a footrace at sports day,
they bought me flowers that shared the same name.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"She said, 'You won today because you worked
hard every day. These flowers are your reward
for trying your best'..."

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...That's right, I...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
……That's suuuch a great story.
Alright, let's hype it up with that!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
You've got a great look on your face too.
Having your favorite things blows all the negativity away, right?!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"...Yes! Thanks to you,
I realized something important.
I can't go collapsing in a place like this!"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Love it, love it!
Let's give our mental strength a massive boost with some nails!
Glam it up, glam it up, make it super flashy!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Alright, let's make it super snappy!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu, yes!
Senpai, please take care of it!!
And so, Tosen Jordan gave her nails a flashy upgrade, boosting her mood right along with them.
